blurb: The Museum is located in Puente de Sabiñánigo (Huesca), in the central Pyrenees (Spain). It is housed in a splendid rural architectural gem going back to the 1800’s. It opened in 1979 and is the happy combination of the vision, labor and creativity of sculptor Angel Orensanz, the Amigos del Serrablo Association (Friends of the Serrablo); and the City Council of Sabiñánigo.
